product: Deepgram — text to speech, streaming (Speak WebSocket)

source_audio.description: No audio was submitted and no request was issued: this frame is authored to Deepgram's published Speak-streaming protocol documentation, not captured from the service. The Metadata message carries no audio and no synthesized text, so no spoken content is involved at all.

redaction.notes: Nothing was redacted because nothing was captured. The three GUID-shaped fields the documented schema carries (request_id, model_uuid and the single entry of additional_model_uuids) hold the nil GUID — the placeholder form protocol section 4 prescribes for a correlating identifier — because no real request or model instance exists to name. model_name and model_version are our own fiction and deliberately do not name a real Deepgram voice.

terms.basis: docs/guides/provider-recording-protocol.md section 7 — Deepgram is not-cleared for capturing Output, so this fixture takes the documentation-derived route, which contains no Output at all

source_schema.method: The documented field set, types and cardinality of the server-to-client Metadata message were read from the page above: type, request_id, model_name, model_version, model_uuid and additional_model_uuids (an array). The frame conforms to that schema. No vendor example payload, prose or field description was copied — only the documented field names and the literal message-type constant 'Metadata', which is interface, not expression. Every value is our own fiction.

notes: This is the fixture that carries the measured field-set finding for this surface. DeepgramTtsServerMessage models type, request_id, model_name, model_version, sequence_id, description and code — so `model_uuid` and `additional_model_uuids` are documented fields the SDK does NOT model, and they reach the parser here as unmodelled siblings. The hand-authored object this fixture retires carried neither. What this artifact is worth: a documented schema is what the vendor says it sends, whereas a capture is what it actually sent on one day. Re-read the source_schema URL first when this suite starts failing; the page publishes no revision marker, so a silent breaking edit is indistinguishable from no edit at all.
